::: {#def-homogenous-random-network-interference .theorem}
# Homogenous random network interference

An exposure mapping exhibits homogeneous random network interference with respect to a [random graph set](#def-random-graph) $\{\psi_t\}_{t \in [1:K]}$ if it is separable and all its [component functions](#def-separability) are [network exposure mappings](#def-network-exposure-mapping). An NPSEM exhibits homogenous random network interference if all its exposure mappings exhibit homogenous random network interference. 

:::
